title.zh: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
title.en: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude

current_state.zh: Anthropic researchers describe using Claude to iteratively redesign quantum circuits, exploiting automated verification to strip out components only needed for extremely rare inputs and produce more efficient circuit implementations than prior manual optimization.
